title: Schedule of Rates and Rate Discounts — Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
The contract rates of Equipment & Vehicle Loans are set from this schedule. A fixed contract rate is read by term band: the rate of the first band whose longest term is at least the loan term. A variable rate, where the product offers one, is tied to the Association Variable Base Rate.

## Fixed rate sheet (annual %, by term band)

| Product | Band 1 | Band 2 | Band 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | terms up to 36 months: 7.24 | up to 48 months: 7.39 | up to 60 months: 7.54 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | up to 36 months: 4.99 | up to 48 months: 5.49 | up to 60 months: 5.99 |
| Used Equipment Loan | up to 36 months: 7.15 | up to 48 months: 7.3 | up to 60 months: 7.45 |
| New Equipment Loan | up to 36 months: 6.95 | up to 60 months: 7.1 | up to 84 months: 7.35 |
| Irrigation System Loan | up to 60 months: 7.05 | up to 84 months: 7.25 | up to 120 months: 7.55 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | up to 60 months: 7.0 | up to 120 months: 7.45 | up to 144 months: 7.7 |

## Variable rate, floor, discounts and day count

| Product | Variable rate available | Spread over the Association Variable Base Rate (points) | Rate floor (annual %) | Autopay discount (points) | Relationship discount (points) | Most both discounts may take off together (points) | Autopay collection available | Day-count convention |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | no | 0 | 5.5 | 0.25 | 0.1 | 0.25 | yes | actual/365 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | no | 0 | 3.99 | 0 | 0 | 0 | yes | actual/365 |
| Used Equipment Loan | yes | 0.75 | 5.5 | 0.25 | 0.15 | 0.35 | yes | actual/365 |
| New Equipment Loan | yes | 0.5 | 5.25 | 0.25 | 0.15 | 0.35 | yes | actual/365 |
| Irrigation System Loan | yes | 0.4 | 5.25 | 0.25 | 0.2 | 0.4 | yes | actual/365 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | yes | 0.35 | 5.25 | 0.25 | 0.2 | 0.4 | yes | actual/365 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Fixed rate sheet** — the fixed contract rate by term band: the rate of the first band whose longest term is at least the loan term.
- **Variable rate available** — whether a variable rate tied to the Association Variable Base Rate may be chosen.
- **Spread** — percentage points over the Association Variable Base Rate for a variable-rate loan; 0 where variable is unavailable.
- **Rate floor** — the lowest contract rate after discounts, annual %.
- **Autopay discount** — the discount for installments collected by automatic debit, in percentage points.
- **Relationship discount** — the discount when the member holds an operating line in active status, in percentage points.
- **Most both discounts may take off together** — the most the autopay and relationship discounts may take off together, in percentage points (the rate discount cap).
- **Day-count convention** — the interest day-count convention; actual/365 means principal multiplied by the annual rate and divided by 365 for each calendar day.
- **Autopay collection available** — whether installments can be collected by automatic debit.

## Reading the rate sheet

- Hypothetical: a Used Equipment Loan with a 42-month term takes the first band whose longest term is at least 42 months, the 48-month band, at 7.3; a 36-month term takes the 36-month band at 7.15.
- Hypothetical: an Irrigation System Loan with a 96-month term takes the 120-month band at 7.55.
- The EquipDirect Dealer Contract shows zero autopay discount, zero relationship discount and a zero cap; the Truck & Trailer Loan and the EquipDirect Dealer Contract offer no variable rate.
